name: m4-flatten-refined-210
description: What does [retronym/scala#210](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/210) (flatten intersections that a type map puts in a refinement's parents) save on its `2.13.x` base? One full compile per op, for scala and pekko-actor plus pekko-stream.

`base` and `baseaa` are the same build of `upstream/2.13.x`, the A/A control. Release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26, 8G heap; xctrace ipc for cycles and instructions. Warmup comes from the plateaus of the m4 cells of `m4-integ-pekko-kperf`, `m4-whs-hash-pekko` and `m4-devirt-subst-prof`.
